description:
An exceptional well-presented detached five-bedroom, two reception family home occupying an attractive site in a peaceful setting, built c. 2004, approx 192.16 (m2) 2,068 sq.ft, set on approx 0.7-acre (0.29 hectares) site with hardcore driveway and detached block-built garage to the rear, the property combines the appeal of a traditional cut-stone front façade with the practical layout for a modern family home. Superbly located for school bus route to post primary school in Athboy at Brownstown GAA which is 2 mins from the residence. And primary school bus route at the old Hurlers Rest Pub just down from the residence for Clonmellon. Located approx 16km to Athboy, 9km to the historical village of Fore. Delvin approx 8km, Collinstown 9km, Castlepollard 14km, Mullingar 28km and an hour’s drive to Dublin Airport.

The ground floor accommodation briefly comprises of a welcoming entrance hallway with laminate flooring. To one side there is a fabulous open plan kitchen/dining/living room with modern fitted wall and floor units offering ample storage and work space with Quart’s worktop, feature Stoves Range with seven gas rings, a hot plate and four electric ovens, Antique mirror splashback and large kitchen island, laminate flooring, dual aspect and patio doors to the side garden. Utility with fitted units, integrated appliances and guest WC. The sitting room is very spacious with dual aspect, laminate flooring and solid fuel stove set into a brick surround. The downstairs double bedroom is currently being used as a home office and has a tiled ensuite.

The first floor comprises of the spacious landing with carpet flooring, walk in hot-press and window with front aspect allowing natural light to seep through. Four double bedrooms all with carpet flooring, the master bedroom has a front aspect with walk in wardrobe and fully tiled recently refurbished ensuite. The family bathroom is recently refurbished, beautifully tiled and contains a four-piece suite including a free-standing bath.

The exterior of this home is well maintained with a cut stone boundary front wall and double gated entrance, hardcore driveway and yard, gardens mainly in lawn with kerbs, mature shrubberies and hedging. To the rear there is a block-built garage with concrete base, power supply and electric roller door.

Located in a wonderful countryside setting yet still close to amenities both social and essential including Delvin which has a primary school, creche, post office, credit union, pharmacy, hardware, local shops, GAA club, pubs and easy access to N4 motorway. Castlepollard for post primary education, hotel, shops and Collinstown village famed for the Blue Flag Lake Lough Lene for fishing, swimming and water sport.

Viewing highly recommended.
